The word Pentateuch is a Greek term meaning 'five scrolls'. – Slide 1

In this photo provided by the Human Adaptation Institute on Saturday, April 24, 2021, members of the team taking part in the "Deep Time" study gather in the Lombrives Cave in Ussat les Bains, France. After 40 days in voluntary isolation, 15 people participating in a scientific experiment have emerged from a vast cave in southwestern France. Eight men and seven women lived in the dark, damp depths of the Lombrives cave in the Pyrenees to help researchers understand how people adapt to drastic changes in living conditions and environments. They had no clocks, no sunlight and no contact with the world above. (Human Adaptation Institute via AP)
